\caption{\rev{Distributional, moment, and temporal diagnostics against the reference fine trajectory. SW is the sliced Wasserstein distance over 16 fixed directions. The remaining columns are absolute errors in mean energy $\|u\|_2^2/d$, mean $x_1$, the mean neighbour product, mean $x_1x_3$, and first-coordinate autocorrelation (AC) at lag 0.5. The neighbour product is $x_1x_2$ for Lorenz-63 and $d^{-1}\sum_i x_ix_{i-1}$ for Lorenz-96. The fine-baseline rows use the independent fine trajectory. Entries are means over eight spun-up replicate pairs; these diagnostic means carry no uncertainty intervals.}}\label{tab:observables_full}\\
